title: Gương vỡ
about: A new piece in the dem-diu style (round 12): 63 bpm in 3/4, C# minor that keeps slipping to chords a third away (C#m to Am, C#m to Fm, F to C#m), each sharing one note with the last, so the tune bends from C# to C and back like a cracked reflection; broken chords (arp), a climax that touches E6, doubled an octave down.
